## Facts

- Role: Engineering Manager at Housecall Pro, leading a team of 6 engineers on the web platform behind housecallpro.com
- Previously: Staff WordPress Developer, then Senior WordPress Developer, at Housecall Pro (joined as Senior in 2024, promoted to Staff, then to Engineering Manager)
- Before Housecall Pro: Technical Lead and Software Engineer at Genera
- Location: Brazil, working with US teams, fluent in English
- 12+ years building for the web
- Open source: maintainer of two WooCommerce plugins on WordPress.org (shipping-by-CEP plugin peaked at 2,000+ active installs and has nearly 20,000 downloads; add-multiple-products-to-cart plugin has 200+ active installs and a 5-star rating)
- Contact: contact@alvsconcelos.dev
